mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_credit_record (credit_id, merchant_id, amount, order_id) VALUES (#{creditId}, #{merchantId}, #{amount, typeHandler=com.example.tradesystem.user.infrastructure.mapper.MoneyTypeHandler}, #{orderId})
mapper.select: SELECT credit_id, merchant_id, amount, order_id, created_at FROM merchant_credit_record WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
